name: The Gardener
s: El jardinero tells the story of Elmer and his controlling mother, La China Jurado, who runs a garden centre that hides another thriving underground murder-for-hire business. Killing is easy for Elmer. An accident has left him emotionless. However, while planning the murder of Violet, a charming nursery school teacher, he falls in love with her. Elmer must learn to love while his mother does …

paragraphs.text: The Gardener () is a Spanish romantic thriller television series created by . It stars Álvaro Rico, Catalina Sopelana, and Cecilia Suárez.
